title: The 5 Longest Animals on Earth, Ranked (#1 Isn't a Whale)

scenes.text: The five longest animals on Earth, ranked. The blue whale isn't number one, or even number two.

scenes.label: Sei whale · ~20 m
scenes.text: Number five: the sei whale. Around twenty meters long, still longer than a school bus.

scenes.label: Fin whale · up to 27 m
scenes.text: Number four: the fin whale. Up to about twenty-seven meters, the second-longest whale alive today.

scenes.label: Blue whale · ~30 m
scenes.text: Number three: the blue whale. Around thirty meters, with the longest ever recorded reaching about thirty-three.

scenes.label: Lion's mane · 36 m tentacles
scenes.text: Number two: the lion's mane jellyfish. One reported specimen had tentacles about thirty-six meters long.

scenes.label: Bootlace worm · up to 55 m
scenes.text: Number one: the bootlace worm, a ribbon worm. Reported up to fifty-five meters, washed ashore in Scotland in eighteen sixty-four.

description:
The five longest animals on Earth, ranked by length.
From the sei whale to a worm reported at up to fifty-five meters, which beats the blue whale.
Which of these would you least want to find on a beach?
first_comment: Which one surprised you most? And what should we rank next?
